content:
maria: Heads-up — seeing egress queueing to KMS privatelink from eu-west1. GPU nodes failing to fetch ephemeral keys, warm pool shrinking.
omkar: Yep, noticed spike. NATGW data processed up, keystore proxy throwing timeouts: `keystore-proxy: timeout waiting for KMS 1200ms`.
jessica: Cost alert — NAT GW processed bytes +45% over 3h. If we move traffic to PrivateLink we pay endpoint costs + infra work. Tradeoffs? :thinking_face: 
ryan: PrivateLink reduces egress and latency but needs 2 endpoints per AZ and infra perms. It will also clear the audit ingestion backlog.
infra-bot: Alert: gpu-warmup-failure-rate > 5% in eu-west1 (15m window).
security-bot: Audit pipeline: KMS decrypt errors +12%, retention lag ~2h.
maria: Short-term mitigations: increase NATGW burst, expand warm pool, and consider audit sampling to relieve Kinesis pressure.
omkar: We can bump NATGW capacity, but sustained bump ~ $1.2k/day in eu-west1. Sampling audit logs to 25% would cut ingestion cost ~60%.
jessica: 25% sampling OK for emergency only. Need SRE + Security sign-off and ensure no PII paths sampled.
ryan: I can add warm pool nodes in ~10m, but KMS rate-limit may still be the choke.
maria: Workaround idea: route keystore reads to a cached regional replica to reduce decrypt QPS. Thoughts?
omkar: Cache TTL is 30s for security reasons, so limited benefit. But we can prefetch ephemeral keys during warmup window — prefetch ~10 keys per instance. I'll prototype.
jessica: Good plan. Two-prong: prefetch + NATGW bump. I'll queue infra change and request security signoff for sampling.
ryan: I'll scale warm pool and watch metrics. If warmup failure < 1% in 30m we'll roll NATGW back.
maria: Action items: @omkar draft prefetch PR, @jessica request sampling approval + cost signoff, @ryan scale warm pool + monitor. I'll open RFC for permanent fix (privatelink + regional keystore replicas).
omkar: PR created: `github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4821` — implements prefetch + telemetry. Deploying canary to eu-west1 now.
infra-bot: Deploy started: canary to eu-west1 (deploy-1234).
jessica: Security ack requested for 25% audit sampling (temp). @security-team please advise.
security-team: Temporarily ok for 25% sampling for non-PII streams, 2h window max. Must notify customers if retention SLAs affected.
ryan: Canary looks good — warmup-failures down from 6.2% -> 0.8% in 18m.
maria: :tada: Nice. Keep monitoring — NATGW cost still a risk if traffic stays high.
omkar: Post-deploy logs:
```
[info] prefetch=10 keys ok avg_latency=80ms
[debug] kms_decrypt_success=98.5% qps=150
```
maria: I'll draft RFC for regional keystore replicas + PrivateLink rollouts. Rough cost estimate: infra + endpoints ~ $8k/month but should cut per-token egress and reduce overall ops complexity.
jessica: Thanks team. I'll close out once RFC + security memo posted.
